settings.audio_spectrum.label: Audio reactive
settings.audio_spectrum.description: Make the visualizer react to the PipeWire audio spectrum.
settings.sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
settings.sensitivity.description: Gain applied to the audio spectrum bars. Lower = calmer.
settings.smoothing.label: Smoothing
settings.smoothing.description: Damps how fast the bars move. Higher = smoother and calmer (0 = raw, snappy).
settings.show_visualizer.label: Show visualizer
settings.visualizer_position.label: Visualizer position
settings.visualizer_position.description: Side the visualizer sits on, relative to the transport buttons (top / bottom on a vertical bar).
settings.bar_count.label: Visualizer bars
settings.bar_count.description: Number of spectrum bars to draw.
settings.accent_color.label: Accent color
settings.accent_color.description: Color of the bars, title and buttons.
settings.cc_context.label: Control Center view
settings.cc_context.description: Control Center view opened when clicking the visualizer.
